test_m3 = '''"""Tests for milestone m3: Save name/html/data-toc-label tokens and unescape before slugify."""

import pytest


def test_toc_tokens_has_three_keys():
    """Test that each toc_tokens entry contains 'name', 'html', and 'data-toc-label' keys.

    R4/R5 require all three keys to be present in every toc_tokens entry.
    """
    import markdown
    md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'attr_list'])
    md.convert('# Foo & Bar{: data-toc-label="Custom & Label"}')
    tokens = md.toc_tokens
    assert len(tokens) >= 1
    entry = tokens[0]
    assert 'name' in entry, f"Missing 'name' key in toc_tokens entry: {entry.keys()}"
    assert 'html' in entry, f"Missing 'html' key in toc_tokens entry: {entry.keys()}"
    assert 'data-toc-label' in entry, f"Missing 'data-toc-label' key in toc_tokens entry: {entry.keys()}"


def test_name_from_data_toc_label_with_striptags():
    """Test that the 'name' field comes from data-toc-label processed through striptags.

    When a heading has data-toc-label, the name should be derived from that label
    via striptags (not from get_name/stashedHTML2text). Entities must be preserved.
    """
    import markdown
    md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'attr_list'])
    md.convert('# Foo & Bar{: data-toc-label="Custom & Label"}')
    tokens = md.toc_tokens
    assert len(tokens) >= 1
    name = tokens[0]['name']
    # The name should be "Custom & Label" (from data-toc-label via striptags)
    # NOT the raw attribute string or the heading text
    assert name == 'Custom & Label', f"Expected 'Custom & Label' but got '{name}'"


def test_data_toc_label_preserved_raw():
    """Test that data-toc-label stores the raw unescaped attribute value.

    The data-toc-label must be the raw unescaped attribute value.
    """
    import markdown
    md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'attr_list'])
    md.convert('# Foo & Bar{: data-toc-label="Custom & Label"}')
    tokens = md.toc_tokens
    assert len(tokens) >= 1
    data_toc_label = tokens[0]['data-toc-label']
    # The raw value should be preserved with entities intact
    assert '&' in data_toc_label, f"data-toc-label was unescaped: '{data_toc_label}'"
    assert data_toc_label == 'Custom & Label'


def test_slug_uses_unescape_before_slugify():
    """Test that the generated id/slug uses html.unescape before slugify.

    R6 requires that html.unescape is called immediately before slugify.
    So '&' becomes '&' before slugification, yielding e.g. 'custom-label'.
    """
    import markdown
    md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'attr_list'])
    md.convert('# Foo & Bar{: data-toc-label="Custom & Label"}')
    tokens = md.toc_tokens
    assert len(tokens) >= 1
    entry_id = tokens[0]['id']
    # The slug should be derived from unescaped label: "Custom & Label" -> "custom-label"
    # If html.unescape was NOT applied before slugify, we would get something like "custom-amp-label"
    # or "custom-amp-label" since & would become just "amp" after tag stripping
    assert entry_id == 'custom-label', f"Expected 'custom-label' but got '{entry_id}'"


def test_html_field_contains_rich_markup():
    """Test that the 'html' field contains the rendered heading inner markup."""
    import markdown
    md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'attr_list'])
    md.convert('# Foo & Bar{: data-toc-label="Custom & Label"}')
    tokens = md.toc_tokens
    assert len(tokens) >= 1
    html_content = tokens[0]['html']
    # The html field should contain the rich inner HTML of the heading
    assert isinstance(html_content, str)
    assert len(html_content) > 0
    # Should contain the entity reference as-is (not unescaped)
    assert '&' in html_content, f"HTML field does not contain entity: '{html_content}'"


def test_entity_not_unescaped_in_name_or_html_or_data_toc_label():
    """Test that html.unescape is NOT applied to name, html, or data-toc-label.

    R6 constraint: html.unescape must NOT be applied to these fields.
    Only the slug/id derivation should use html.unescape.
    """
    import markdown
    md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'attr_list'])
    md.convert('# Test & Entity{: data-toc-label="Label & Value"}')
    tokens = md.toc_tokens
    assert len(tokens) >= 1
    entry = tokens[0]
    # None of the three fields should have unescaped entities
    name = entry['name']
    html_val = entry['html']
    dtl = entry['data-toc-label']
    # Check that & appears as & not as bare & in the stored values
    assert '&' in name, f"name has unescaped entity: '{name}'"
    assert '&' in dtl, f"data-toc-label has unescaped entity: '{dtl}'"
    assert '&' in html_val, f"html has unescaped entity: '{html_val}'"
'''

with open('crucible_hidden/test_m3.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(test_m3)
print("test_m3.py rewritten")
